text: When something goes awry, it does not turn out the way it was planned. Houdini's beer-can escape went awry when the smell made him faint.
To refine something is to make it better by fixing small things, little by little. Houdini read about magic so he could refine his tricks.
To bolster something is to make it stronger or give it extra support. Newspapers, radio and movies helped make magic shows more popular.
An illusionist is a magician who makes people believe they see something impossible, like a person floating or an elephant vanishing.
A spirit is the part of a person that some people believe lives on after death, like a ghost. Houdini's fans tried to call his spirit back.
A spectre is a ghost, something scary and see-through that people think they see. People said Houdini's spectre escaped from handcuffs.
A séance is a meeting where people sit in the dark and try to talk to the dead. Some people said Houdini's spirit showed up at one.
A widow is a woman whose husband has died. Houdini's widow, Bess, waited ten years to hear from him.
A centenary is the 100th anniversary of something. This year is the centenary of Houdini's death.
To conjure up something is to make it appear, as if by magic. Here, fans are bringing Houdini back to people's minds.
To summon someone is to call them to come. Fans gather to summon Houdini's spirit.
Daring means brave enough to do something risky. Houdini was known for his daring tricks.
To recreate something is to make it again the way it was before. Magic shows will recreate Houdini's tricks.
Exhibitions are public displays of art or objects for people to look at, like in a museum.
A bibliophile is a person who loves books and collects them. Houdini owned a big library of magic books.
A showman is a performer who is great at entertaining a crowd and getting attention.
A docuseries is a TV show in several parts that tells a true story, like a documentary.
Here, to render someone means to show them on a screen, created by a computer. The show uses AI to make Houdini appear and speak.
To narrate is to tell a story out loud. The show has an AI Houdini narrate his own life.
A commemoration is an event that helps people remember something important from the past.
A celebrity is a very famous person. The article jokes that Budapest has a celebrity rabbit.
Fanfare is loud, excited attention or celebration around something.
Celebrated means famous and admired by many people. Houdini is probably the most celebrated illusionist of all time.
To haunt a place is to keep showing up there like a ghost. Houdini's name haunts dictionaries, which means it keeps appearing in them.
To trill is to sing or say something in a high, quick, cheerful voice.
A master of mystery is someone who is very skilled at keeping secrets and surprising people.
To promote something is to tell people about it so they will want to buy it or see it. Houdini was very good at promoting himself.
Fame is being known by many, many people.
Here, to polish something is to keep improving it until it is as good as it can be, the way you would polish a shiny stone.
A straitjacket is a special coat with long sleeves that tie behind the back, so the wearer cannot use their arms. Houdini escaped from them.
Here, scholarship means careful study and research about a subject. Houdini studied magic seriously.
Biographies are books that tell the true story of a person's life.
Sorcery is magic done with spells, like in fairy tales.
To be buried alive is to be put under the ground while still living. Houdini made this into an escape trick.
A golden age is the best period for something, when it is at its most popular and successful.
Mass media means newspapers, radio, TV and other ways of reaching many people at once.
An advert is an ad, a notice that tells people to buy something. This word is more common in British English.
To quip is to say something quick, clever and funny.
To dare someone is to challenge them to do something hard or risky.
Here, cranes are tall machines with long arms that lift heavy things. They are not the birds.
A corporate partnership is when a performer and a company work together, like a star advertising a drink.
A brand deal is an agreement where a company pays a famous person to be linked with its product.
A brewer is a person or company that makes beer.
A stench is a very strong, bad smell.
To pass out is to faint, to suddenly lose consciousness.
Headline-worthy means exciting enough to make the front-page news.
The ™ sign means trademark. A trademark is a name or symbol that a business owns, so no one else may use it without permission.
A patent is a government paper that says an invention belongs to its inventor. To get one, you must explain exactly how it works.
Imitators are people who copy someone else.
Copycats are people who copy what someone else does.
To expose a secret is to tell everyone what was hidden.
A playlet is a very short play.
To sue someone is to ask a court to make them pay or stop doing something that hurts you.
To enjoin someone is to have a court order them to stop doing something. The last line is a joke on 'if you can't beat them, join them'.
